It is inspired by the VLAD (Vector-Aware Latent Dirichlet Allocation) method originally proposed for face recognition. In the context of language identification, GhostVLAD is used to aggregate frame-level features into a single utterance-level feature vector, which helps in enhancing the model's ability to distinguish between different languages.
